Request an appointment

Questionnaires

Questionnaires to prepare your appointment

You enter the key facts, the notary's office prepares the draft. Complete on screen or print. Your details are transmitted to and stored at the notary's office in encrypted form, without any third-party service. Appointments are made by telephone.

Property

Purchase Agreement: House or Land

For drafting a purchase agreement for a house, plot of land or apartment.

Open questionnaire

Purchase Agreement: Condominium

For buying or selling a condominium apartment.

Open questionnaire

Land Charge (Mortgage) Registration

For registering a land charge (Grundschuld) in favour of a bank, for example to finance a purchase or renovation.

Open questionnaire

Transfer and Gift of Property

For transferring a house, apartment or plot of land during your lifetime, usually to children.

Open questionnaire

Wills and Inheritance

Will and Inheritance Contract

For drafting an individual will, a joint will of spouses or an inheritance contract.

Open questionnaire

Certificate of Inheritance and Disclaimer

After a death: application for a certificate of inheritance, disclaimer of an inheritance, or distribution of the estate among heirs.

Open questionnaire

Powers of Attorney

Lasting Power of Attorney and Living Will

For drafting a lasting power of attorney, a living will and a guardianship directive.

Open questionnaire

Family

Marriage Contract

Before or during marriage: matrimonial property regime, maintenance, pension rights adjustment, protection of a business.

Open questionnaire

Divorce Settlement Agreement

On separation and divorce: settle assets, the home, maintenance, pension rights and arrangements for children by agreement.

Open questionnaire

Business

Formation of a GmbH or UG

For the articles of association or model protocol, list of shareholders and commercial register filing.

Open questionnaire

Transfer of GmbH Shares

Sale or gift of GmbH shares, including a shareholder joining or leaving.

Open questionnaire

Commercial Register Filing

Changes for GmbH, UG, sole traders and partnerships: change of managing director, relocation of seat, amendment of articles, commercial power of attorney (Prokura), liquidation.

Open questionnaire

Association Formation and Register

Registration of a new association (Verein) or changes to its board and statutes in the register of associations.

Open questionnaire

Certifications

Certification

Certification of a signature or a certified copy.

Open questionnaire
